skill.name: frontend-dev
skill.description: Build complete frontend pages with structured design rules, motion guidance, MiniMax media generation scripts, copywriting frameworks, and generative art templates.
skill.summary: Frontend build workflow for polished pages, motion systems, AI media assets, and generative art.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate frontend and media-generation workflow, not an obvious malicious package. Most static alerts are markdown, template, license, or font false positives, but the MiniMax scripts perform authenticated network calls, write files, and trust a configurable API base URL.

remediation.issue: MiniMax scripts send the bearer token to a base URL taken from MINIMAX_API_BASE.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the API base against the documented MiniMax domains or require explicit confirmation before using a custom endpoint.
Replace the echo command with a non-revealing check such as testing whether the variable is set.

remediation.issue: Setup documentation includes sudo apt install ffmpeg.
remediation.suggestion: Do not instruct agents to run privileged package installation automatically; ask the user to install system packages manually.

remediation.issue: Asset scripts write to user-provided output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain outputs to the project asset directory or clearly require user approval before writing outside the project.

remediation.issue: The bundle includes many binary font files.
remediation.suggestion: Keep font provenance, hashes, and licenses documented so binary assets can be reviewed during release.

- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS. Check version in `package.json` — NEVER mix v3/v4 syntax.
- **Viewport:** Use `min-h-[100dvh]` not `h-screen`. Use CSS Grid not flex percentage math.
| Typography | Headlines: `text-4xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter`. Body: `text-base leading-relaxed
| Cards | **NEVER** use generic cards when DENSITY > 7. Use `border-t`, `divide-y`, or spacing. |
| States | **ALWAYS** implement: Loading (skeleton), Empty, Error, Tactile feedback (`scale-[0.98]`)
| Forms | Label above input. Error below. `gap-2` for input blocks. |
- **Magnetic Buttons:** Use `useMotionValue`/`useTransform` — never `useState` for continuous animat
- **Animation:** Spring physics (`stiffness: 100, damping: 20`), infinite loops, `React.memo` isolat
- Perpetual animations MUST be in `React.memo` leaf components
- `contain: layout style paint` on heavy containers
- ALWAYS provide visible focus rings (use `outline` not `box-shadow`)
- ALWAYS add `aria-live="polite"` for dynamically revealed content

semantic_findings.description: The MiniMax helper scripts read API_BASE from MINIMAX_API_BASE and send the MINIMAX_API_KEY bearer token to that destination. This permits credential disclosure if the endpoint is misconfigured or influenced by untrusted context.

content.value_statement: Modern frontend work needs design, motion, media, and copy to fit together. This skill guides complete page builds with asset generation, animation patterns, and quality checks.
actual_capabilities: Defines a six-phase workflow for frontend architecture, assets, copy, UI build, and quality gates.
Provides Tailwind, React, Next.js, motion, and accessibility rules for page implementation.
Includes MiniMax scripts for image, video, music, and text-to-speech asset generation.
Includes p5.js templates and canvas fonts for static or interactive generative art.
Documents motion recipes for Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, CSS, and Lottie.
Lists checks for local assets, dependency verification, and responsive behavior.
limitations: MiniMax media generation requires valid MINIMAX_API_KEY and MINIMAX_API_BASE environment variables.
Generated media may use paid external API calls and can take time for video polling.
Dependency installation guidance must be reviewed before running commands in a project.
The skill gives implementation guidance, but final code still needs project-specific tests.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Plan sections, copy, local assets, responsive layout, and motion for a product launch page.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Generate page visuals, background video, voiceover, and music that fit a campaign concept.

use_cases.title: Build Interactive Art
use_cases.description: Use the p5.js viewer template, canvas fonts, and seed controls to create browser-based generative art.

prompt_templates.title: Begin a Landing Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete page plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a landing page for a small business. Include the page structure, visual direction, copy, local asset needs, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Add Motion System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a React and Tailwind page with section-level motion. Choose the right animation tools, include reduced-motion handling, and avoid heavy libraries where CSS works.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Media Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan image, video, music, and text-to-speech assets for a product page. Draft prompts, file names, output folders, and the commands to run after confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Interactive Art
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an interactive p5.js artwork using the viewer template. Define the philosophy, seed behavior, parameters, controls, and refinement checklist.

output_examples.input: Build a hero page for a new fitness app.
output_examples.output: A complete page plan with a bold visual direction, conversion copy, local hero image requirements, animation choices, and responsive quality gates.

output_examples.input: Create a generative poster with browser controls.
output_examples.output: A concept statement, seeded parameter plan, p5.js viewer approach, font choices, and refinement notes for a polished interactive artwork.

output_examples.input: Add cinematic scroll motion to a product story.
output_examples.output: A motion architecture that separates GSAP scroll sections, Framer UI transitions, accessibility controls, and performance limits.

best_practices: Confirm media prompts and costs before running MiniMax generation scripts.
Keep all generated images, videos, and audio in local project asset folders.
Verify dependencies and framework versions before adding animation or 3D libraries.
anti_patterns: Do not use placeholder image URLs or remote stock links in the final page.
Do not mix GSAP and Framer Motion inside the same component.
Do not run privileged install commands without explicit user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill build?
faq.answer: It helps build frontend pages with design direction, motion, media assets, copy, and quality checks.

faq.question: Does it require MiniMax credentials?
faq.answer: Only the media generation scripts require MiniMax environment variables. Pure frontend guidance can be used without them.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate production-ready code?
faq.answer: It provides workflows, templates, and implementation rules. The final project should still be reviewed and tested.

faq.question: What frontend stack does it prefer?
faq.answer: It emphasizes React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, and p5.js.

faq.question: What should users review before installation?
faq.answer: Users should review network calls, environment variable handling, filesystem writes, binary fonts, and dependency install guidance.
